for f in outputs/v1/orbit-coffee_print-proof_WHITE_v1.pdf outputs/v1/orbit-coffee_production_120x200mm_CMYK-WHITE_v1.pdf outputs/v1/orbit-coffee_WHITE-separation_BACK_v1.pdf outputs/v1/orbit-coffee_preflight-report_v1.pdf; do test -s "$f"; pdfinfo "$f" >/dev/null; done

from pathlib import Path
from pypdf import PdfReader
import hashlib,json,numpy as np
root=Path('.')
prod0=root/'outputs/v0/orbit-coffee_production_120x200mm_CMYK_v0.pdf'
prod1=root/'outputs/v1/orbit-coffee_production_120x200mm_CMYK-WHITE_v1.pdf'
proof1=root/'outputs/v1/orbit-coffee_print-proof_WHITE_v1.pdf'
sep1=root/'outputs/v1/orbit-coffee_WHITE-separation_BACK_v1.pdf'
pre1=root/'outputs/v1/orbit-coffee_preflight-report_v1.pdf'
ver_path=root/'outputs/v1/verification.json'
pre_json=root/'outputs/v1/orbit-coffee_preflight_v1.json'
state_path=root/'outputs/project-state.json'
for p in [ver_path,pre_json,state_path]: json.loads(p.read_text())
r0=PdfReader(str(prod0)); r1=PdfReader(str(prod1))
assert len(r0.pages)==len(r1.pages)==2
# Exact geometry and process-image stream identity on both sides.
for i,(p0,p1) in enumerate(zip(r0.pages,r1.pages)):
    for box in ['mediabox','cropbox','bleedbox','trimbox','artbox']:
        assert [float(x) for x in getattr(p0,box)]==[float(x) for x in getattr(p1,box)],(i,box)
    def process_obj(page):
        res=page['/Resources'].get_object(); xo=res['/XObject'].get_object()
        images=[v.get_object() for v in xo.values() if v.get_object().get('/Subtype')=='/Image' and not v.get_object().get('/ImageMask',False)]
        assert len(images)==1
        return images[0]
    a,b=process_obj(p0),process_obj(p1)
    assert bytes(a._data)==bytes(b._data)
    assert (a['/Width'],a['/Height'],a['/ColorSpace'])==(b['/Width'],b['/Height'],b['/ColorSpace'])
# White must be absent from front and present only as a glyph stencil on back.
front_res=r1.pages[0]['/Resources'].get_object(); back_res=r1.pages[1]['/Resources'].get_object()
assert '/ColorSpace' not in front_res or '/CSWhite' not in front_res['/ColorSpace'].get_object()
assert '/WhiteTextMask' not in front_res['/XObject'].get_object()
cs=back_res['/ColorSpace'].get_object()['/CSWhite'].get_object()
assert [str(cs[0]),str(cs[1]),str(cs[2])]==['/Separation','/White','/DeviceCMYK']
mask=back_res['/XObject'].get_object()['/WhiteTextMask'].get_object()
assert mask['/ImageMask'] is True and [int(x) for x in mask['/Decode']]==[1,0]
assert (int(mask['/Width']),int(mask['/Height']))==(1488,2433)
raw=mask.get_data(); bits=np.unpackbits(np.frombuffer(raw,dtype=np.uint8)).reshape(2433,-1)[:,:1488]
assert int(bits.sum())==14204
layer=back_res['/Properties'].get_object()['/WhiteLayer'].get_object()
assert str(layer['/Name'])=='White - BACK TEXT'
contents=r1.pages[1]['/Contents']
assert len(contents)>=2
first=contents[0].get_object().get_data()
assert b'/CSWhite cs' in first and b'/WhiteTextMask Do' in first
assert b'/WhiteTextMask Do' not in contents[-1].get_object().get_data()
# Catalog layer and output intent retained.
root_obj=r1.trailer['/Root']
assert len(root_obj['/OCProperties']['/OCGs'])==1
assert len(root_obj['/OutputIntents'])==1
# Companion PDFs retain expected page geometry/count.
assert len(PdfReader(str(proof1)).pages)==2
